purpose: Classify systemd-facing isolation/resource/security contracts before runtime implementation instead of implementing broad Linux feature parity by guesswork.

classifications.question: Which cgroup v2 files/controllers are mandatory for the selected Step-37 server target?

must_prove: enforcement at canonical resource allocation owners

classifications.question: Which namespace domains are mandatory for the pinned systemd configuration?
classifications.rule: Do not implement a namespace type merely because Linux has it; add only target-proven domains.

must_prove: Linux capability bits never grant Kernal object capabilities

classifications.fallback: explicit Linux-compatible failure or reference-observed systemd fallback

classifications.rule: Filesystem/probe visibility must not silently imply an enabled security module.

negative_invariants: unsupported security APIs cannot broaden authority
cgroup membership teardown leaves no stale accounting or control authority
